Hero.name: Alexander Kranz
Hero.tagline: I study Data Science in Hamburg, connecting data, technology and curiosity – at work, in code and out on the running track.

About.heading: About me
About.lead: I'm passionate about data – and just as much about the people and stories behind it.
paragraphs: I grew up in Ahrensburg and today I'm pursuing a Bachelor's in Data Science in Hamburg. I'm fascinated by how data turns into real decisions – and how technology can improve people's everyday lives.
Back in school I took part in Jugend forscht and Jugend debattiert, where I learned to develop ideas and stand up for them. After graduating, I spent a voluntary year in Ecuador teaching English.
Today I gain hands-on experience as a working student – previously at Otto and currently at Deutsche Bahn. I'm supported by a scholarship from the Studienstiftung des Deutschen Volkes.

items.description: Working on data-driven questions around mobility and infrastructure.
Supporting the data-driven e-commerce environment of one of Europe's largest online retailers.
Degree focused on statistics, machine learning and programming.
Supported by Germany's largest and oldest organisation for the promotion of gifted students.
A year abroad: teaching English, intercultural experience and personal growth.
